observations.text: One recognizable silver-haired mage circles the right hand over the open left palm, building gold rings and an orb. The right hand moves outside the left edge around 1.5 seconds.
The orb brightens and bursts around 2.7 seconds into sparks and one yellow duck on the same left palm. The downward gaze and continuing camera push-in are visible.

The duck remains one recognizable toy, briefly opening its beak. The mage faces camera with a slight smile, but the push-in cuts the base of the left palm and lower duck at the bottom edge. The right hand stays outside the frame, failing the required retained-hand composition.
